custom.label: Will you publish live prices on the new site?
custom.help: This is the single biggest decision. Right now your page titled 'JoJo Vertical Water Tank Prices' says 'Contact us for a quote' on all 39 lines, while Builders, Leroy Merlin, Cashbuild, Plumblink and Takealot all publish theirs. Almost everything else in the build depends on this answer.
options: Show a price range or 'from' price

custom.label: If you're hesitant to publish prices, what's holding you back?
custom.help: Margin protection, a JoJo dealer agreement, competitors undercutting you, prices changing too often — be blunt. There are ways around most of these.

custom.label: How does JoJo send you the monthly price list, and in what format?
custom.help: Excel, PDF, email, a dealer portal login? We want to automate the monthly price update rather than have you retype it.

custom.label: Which contact channels will you actually answer?
custom.help: Tick only what you'll genuinely respond to. Your current site has no phone number at all — that is costing you sales on a R5,000–R20,000 purchase.

custom.label: What hours do you answer enquiries, and how quickly do you normally reply?
Do you want customers to buy and pay online, or stay quote-only?
options: Online checkout for smaller tanks only

custom.label: Which payment methods do you want to accept?
Is selling JoJo-only a contractual obligation, or your own choice?
custom.help: JoJo doesn't sell direct to the public — they route buyers to distributors like you — so the channel is protected. But if you're free to stock a second brand, it widens your price ladder considerably.

custom.label: Would you consider stocking other brands or accessories (pumps, filters, first-flush diverters, stands, fittings)?
custom.help: Accessories usually carry far better margin than the tank itself.

custom.label: Who is the priority customer for the new site?
custom.help: Your current homepage says 'BULK ORDER SPECIALISTS' but the site is built for a homeowner buying one tank. We should build for one and accommodate the other.
options: Homeowner buying one or two tanks
Genuinely mixed — need all of them

custom.label: Who do you NOT want as a customer, and which enquiries waste your time?
custom.help: Just as useful as knowing who you do want. Tyre-kickers, tiny orders, unreachable delivery addresses, price-shoppers?

custom.label: Roughly how many enquiries and orders do you get per month now, and what's your average order value?
custom.help: Ranges are fine. This tells us what a realistic improvement target looks like.

custom.label: Of the people who email you for a quote, roughly what share actually buy — and where do the rest fall away?
Walk us through how delivery actually works today, start to finish.
custom.help: Who dispatches (you or the JoJo depot), lead times, who pays, whether the driver offloads, what happens on a farm with no forklift, and which areas you can't reach or won't service.

custom.label: How is delivery priced?
custom.help: Every competitor hides this behind 'standard delivery fees apply'. If we can show a real number at the customer's postcode, that alone is a differentiator.

custom.label: Which provinces or areas can you deliver to profitably, and which are marginal?
Do you hold any stock yourself, or does everything dispatch from JoJo depots?
Would you build a vetted installer network and take a referral fee, rather than saying 'we don't do installation'?
custom.help: Your site currently disclaims installation on five pages, and the 'Recommended Installers' page promises a list and then shows nothing. This is the biggest fixable leak on the site — and it costs you nothing to broker.

custom.label: Do you already know installers you'd happily refer? Who and where?
What's your typical margin band on a tank, and on accessories?
custom.help: This will never be published — it tells us how hard you can compete on price and where to push the bundles.

custom.label: Describe your bulk and commercial orders — who buys, typical sizes, payment terms, and whether you do tender work.
Which competitors take deals off you most often, and why do you think you lose?
custom.help: Builders and Leroy Merlin? RotoTank? Facebook and Gumtree sellers at R3,999? Another JoJo dealer?

custom.label: When you DO win the deal, why does the customer choose you over the big retailers?
custom.help: Whatever you say here becomes the core message of the new homepage.

custom.label: Can we photograph real installations and collect reviews from past customers?
custom.help: Every competitor uses JoJo's stock renders. Real South African installs — a smallholding, a suburban side-passage, a school — would separate you instantly.
options: Yes — we have customers who'd agree
Some — a few we could ask

custom.label: Upload anything you already have: install photos, logo files, price lists, brochures.
Tag each proposed feature by how much you need it.
custom.help: Must = we don't launch without it · Should = important · Could = nice to have · Not-yet = a later phase. Be honest — everything tagged Must costs time and money.
options: Water Security Planner (roof size + rainfall = tank size)
Delivery cost & lead time at your postcode
Complete system packages (tank + stand + pump + filter)

custom.label: Who handles enquiries and orders day to day, and how many of you are there?
custom.help: A site that generates ten times the enquiries only helps if someone can answer them.

custom.label: What do you use to run orders today — email, spreadsheets, Xero, Sage, something else?
Do you have logins for the domain, hosting, Google Analytics and Google Search Console?
custom.help: We need these to migrate without losing the rankings you already have. If you don't know, say so and we'll work it out.

custom.label: Your blog has hundreds of posts across 150+ categories. Keep it, prune it, or drop it?
custom.help: Some of it genuinely ranks — a 2017 post of yours sits at #2 for 'rainwater harvesting calculator South Africa'. Most of it is noise diluting the rest.
options: Keep only the posts that rank or convert

custom.label: Keep the Rainharvest name and blue-drop branding, or is a refresh on the table?
custom.help: The brief is 'modern cinematic premium', which the current blue/yellow/green treatment can't carry.
